strings.en: 1. Destroy all enemies
1. All allies destroyed
Raideeeen!! Faaaade In!!
Raaaideeeen!!
A natural fortress like no other...
Now that the Star of La Mu is in our hands, it seems the Demon Empire
can't afford to be choosy about its methods.
Heh! We've had guys try to ram a whole planet into us, you know?
Like this is gonna surprise me now!
But they never reached the surface. These guys are already here...
But hey, how come they're not making any moves?
They're not just gonna ram the island into us and call it a day, are they?
...No, Mister. They're waiting, I think.
Akira...?
They mean to take us on... head-on...!
The Demon Empire must be pretty cornered, too.
Brings back memories, doesn't it, Ryoma?
The Hyakki fortress island... right.
Heh, come to think of it, they rammed their whole fortress into us too.
You came for the Star of La Mu, but that's where your luck runs out!
Are you ready to sortie!? All units, launch!
Seeing it up close... it's huge.
It's creepy... the way it's just sitting there so close by...
Hey, Show, how does this island... move?
...How should I know?
It is Demon Emperor Barao's psychokinesis...
Psychokinesis...?
What's psychokinesis?
Who knows... Maybe it's something like Aura Power...?
I'll never understand things on the surface...
Raideen also moves by Akira's psychokinesis...
I don't really get it either... It's the power of the heart.
It's what makes Raideen move, I guess... I've never noticed it...
Yes... psychokinesis! Akira Hibiki!
Heh, so you're finally showing your face!
Barao! So you're Demon Emperor Barao!
Indeed! A grudge twelve thousand years old...! I'll settle it, Raideen!
Come forth! Demon Beasts! And the Kyoretsu Beast Corps!
They must have taken the bait of the Star of La Mu, but...
Looks like we hooked a pretty big fish, Tetsuya.
Attacking us with their whole home base...
...What Barao is after is the Star of La Mu...!
Leave it to us, Mom!
We can't let the Star of La Mu be used! We'll beat them ourselves!
Curse you, humans! Behold the might of the demons, Barao's true power!
I shall shatter heaven, rend the earth, and tear you humans to pieces!
This is... a Great Kyoretsu Beast! Go to emergency defense status!
This day, I shall obtain the Star of La Mu for you, my lord!
I shall lay their heads before our great Lord Barao!
Raideen killed my brother! I shall defeat it without fail, my lord!
Doctor! That Kyoretsu Beast's face looks just like Gorai's!
Don't tell me... Gorai is...!
Gorai himself became a Kyoretsu Beast... This is their final stand!
Kill them all, and the Mutron shall be mine!
The battle of twelve thousand years ago... It'll end the same way this time!
Demon Emperor Barao! Raaaaaai!
Wh... Whaaat... Me...? Akira Hibikiii!
It's over... Gekido Kyoretsu...!
Impossible... This is...
Nngh, guooooh... Raideen... Even if I fall... Lord Barao...
Do not underestimate the power of Lord Barao...!
Oh, ohhhhh! You wretches!
Go back to hell! Gorai Kyoretsu...!
Impossible! Big Brother!
Again... Am I to be defeated yet again!? Ooooooohhh!
So long...!
Gekido! You at least! You at least must defeat them!
Big Brother! How pathetic! Losing to mere humans!
Lord Barao... my strength failed! Glory to the Great Demon Empire!
Ooooooohhh!
Haaaaah...!
Akira...!
Incredible... Akira, you son of a gun...!
Ooooooohhh!
See that, Barao!? We beat Baragoon too!
Nngh! Don't get cocky, humans!!
Nngh! Don't get cocky, humans!!
Gu, guoooooooooooh!
Is this the end of Barao...!?
We beat him...! You did it, Hibiki!
You gave us a lot of trouble! Now disappear...!
I-Impossible... That I would... Gunuuuuu...
The Hyakki boss said something just like that!
This is what happens when you look down on humans!
Why...? Why are those beings...!
...Why...? Even though those beings... are not here...
why... am I defeated yet again...!?
Those beings? Does he mean the Einst series from the tablet...?
This time... the Age of Demons was to be realized...
That's... one down...!
Oh, oh... Gekido...! Curse you, Raideen! How dare you do this to my brother...!
Don't worry, you're next. You'd better be ready.
Gekido... I will... I will surely avenge him!
Barao! The Kyoretsu brothers have fallen! Now it's your turn!
How long are you gonna keep hiding!? Show yourself!
Ohhh! Akira Hibiki! Beating the Kyoretsu brothers made you cocky!
That is... There's no mistake... Demon Emperor Barao...!
So this is Barao's true form...!
It's enormous!?
Twelve thousand years ago... there was a monster like this!?
You mustn't falter!
That gave me a little shiver.
Heh, if anything, I'm shaking with excitement...!
It seems the title of Emperor isn't just for show... But I won't lose!
I'm not afraid... of any enemy...!
Akira Hibiki! Today I avenge my clan, which perished because of you!
I'll send you back to hell... just like the Kyoretsu brothers!
Come on! Barao!
Just like Gekido and Gorai...?
Hwaaa ha ha ha! Akira Hibiki, they have gone to no such place!
Behold! Baraoooooooo!
Whaaat!?
What's he going to do!?
No... It can't be...
With twelve thousand years of demon curses... from my steel-hard claws
and my hair, I shall birth the guardian dragon of the demons!
Come forth, Baragoon...!
What's that? That dragon-looking enemy!
Gorai! Gekido! You shall fight on even in death!
Ooooooooohhh!
Gaaaaaaah!
Ah! In the hands of that enemy called Baragoon...!
What is it!? Aina!
It's got the heads of the Kyoretsu brothers from before on it...
What!? Dammit! Even in death, they're still getting in our way!?
The souls of the dead, however wicked, must go to the land of rest,
Byston Well... And yet...
How horrible... To disturb the sleep of the dead...
The sleep of the dead!? Don't make me laugh!
It is for the victory of my Great Demon Empire, and of Barao himself!
If their lives are spent for that cause, Gorai and Gekido are overjoyed!
What an infuriating bastard!
Say what you will! Go forth, guardian dragon of the demons! Baragoon!
Seize the Star of La Mu so the Age of Demons may come to pass!
What!?
Queen Sheela...! What is that!?
The Einst series...
Why are they here...?
So the Einst are after the Star of La Mu as well...
So you've come... Will you hinder us just as you did back then...!?
Reiko... You know, don't you...? If you use the Star of La Mu, your body...
I understand... But if my life can destroy the demons... and the Einst...
...Believe in Akira... in all of them... Reiko.
Dear...
Is it just me, or do they always show up right when we don't want them to?
Showing up when things are already complicated!
They sure don't care about our schedule.
What timing! Geez!
BAD TIMING!
Complaining won't get us anywhere.
They should be hostile to the demons too... That's the one saving grace...
All units! Destroy both the demons and the Einst! Understood!?
Oh... Akira...
Gekido, Gorai, and even Baragoon...!
Raideen... Akira has...
What incredible spirit...
It's kinda scary...
Akira Hibiki... no, Raideen! Will you defy me to the bitter end!?
You fool!
D-Dear! The Star of La Mu!?
What is this light!? Oh, it's heading toward Raideen!?
Whoaaaaaa!?
Dr. Hibiki! What happened!? Raideen's...!
This is... I sense power. What is it!?
Hibiki! Hibiki! What happened!? Are you all right!?
Wh-What is this...? Power... Raideen's filling with tremendous power!
Lemuria! If you release the power of the Mutron... your body will...!
No, I haven't done anything! This is... the Star of La Mu, the Mutron...
Ooooohhh!
Raideen has recognized Akira as a true hero...!?
Nngh, I won't allow it! I won't allow it!
Look at their numbers!
Tch, this could be a pain... Huh!? Raideen!?
Raaaaideeeeeen!
God Voice is now available.
So this is the power of the Mutron! This is...!
Uoooooh, insolent wretch! I shall crush you!
Do not think my power is the same as it was twelve thousand years ago!
Whatever you've become... the result's the same! Barao! Here I come!
The demons... are wiped out. We did it...
We've repelled all the Einst as well.
...I did it... Mom...
Akira... at last... at last you've defeated Demon Emperor Barao...
Well done... Akira, you fought so well to get this far...!
Dad...!
A battle from twelve thousand years ago... settled at last.
Yeah, Akira! Good for you!
Thanks, Koji.
So does that mean the enemies on the surface are more or less dealt with?
All we did was chase off that bastard Shapiro, though.
...Mm. But the enemies based on the surface should be dealt with...
That leaves...
The invaders from other worlds...
And the Einst... still shrouded in mystery...
In any case, we must consider our next move.
Good work, everyone... All units, return to your ships!
